title: Jeff's Farm — EN/FR/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar French Portuguese language learning warm baritone 100bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe farm portrait character
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Jeff walked the rows before dawn.
When he spoke, they listened. Respect earned slow.
They left the farm. But they brought it with them.
Jeff's farm — still in how they carry themselves.

[Verse 2 - French, with English translations]
Jeff marchait dans les rangs avant l'aube. (Jeff walked the rows before dawn.)
Quand il parlait, ils écoutaient. Respect gagné lentement. (When he spoke, they listened. Respect earned slow.)
Ils ont quitté la ferme. Mais ils l'ont emportée avec eux. (They left the farm. But they brought it with them.)
La ferme de Jeff — encore dans leur façon de se porter. (Jeff's farm — still in how they carry themselves.)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
A fazenda de Jeff (Jeff's farm)
Onde os trabalhadores voltavam toda manhã (Where the workers came back every morning)
A fazenda de Jeff (Jeff's farm)
Onde o respeito era conquistado e mantido (Where respect was earned and kept)
A fazenda de Jeff (Jeff's farm)
Onde a poeira vermelha conta histórias (Where the red dust tells the stories)
Que as pessoas já conhecem (That the people there already know)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Between Jeff and Jill they held a world together. Red dust mornings. That high African sky.
French: Entre Jeff et Jill, ils ont tenu un monde ensemble. Matins de poussière rouge. Ce grand ciel africain. (Between Jeff and Jill they held a world. Red dust mornings. That high African sky.)
Portuguese: Entre Jeff e Jill, eles sustentaram um mundo juntos. Manhãs de poeira vermelha. Aquele alto céu africano. (Between Jeff and Jill a world held. Red dust mornings. That high African sky.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Jeff's farm — still here
French: La ferme de Jeff — encore là (Jeff's farm — still here)
Portuguese: A fazenda de Jeff — ainda aqui (Jeff's farm — still here)
